other_conditions: Must have passed the class‑10th Pre‑Board/Pre‑Test exam from a government‑recognized school in Tripura with at least 50% marks.
Must be appearing for the class 10th board final examination.
Must be a resident of Tripura.
Eligibility category noted in source: Person with Disability
benefits_summary: Provides free coaching (up to ₹1,00,000) and accommodation (₹1,40,000 per annum) for a two‑year JEE/NEET preparation program at a reputed institution outside Tripura.
